name: Gmail Trigger
category_description: Trigger node - starts a workflow when an event happens
description: Gmail is an email service developed by Google. The Gmail Trigger node can start a workflow based on events in Gmail

parameters.name: Credential to connect with
parameters.description: Select or create a new Google credential to use for the trigger. Refer to Google credentials for more information on setting up a new credential

parameters.name: Poll Times
parameters.description: Select a poll Mode to set how often to trigger the poll. Your Mode selection will add or remove relevant fields. Refer to Poll Mode options to configure the parameters for each mode type

parameters.name: Simplify
parameters.description: Choose whether to return a simplified version of the response (turned on, default) or the raw data (turned off)

parameters.name: Max Emails per Poll
parameters.description: Enter the maximum number of emails the node fetches per poll cycle. The default is 10, with a maximum of 50. If there are more unread emails than the limit, the node queues the remaining emails and fetches them in the next poll cycle

parameters.name: Include Spam and Trash
parameters.description: Select whether the node should trigger on new messages in the Spam and Trash folders (turned on) or not (turned off)

parameters.name: Label Names or IDs
parameters.description: Only trigger on messages with the selected labels added to them. Select the Label names you want to apply or enter an expression to specify IDs. The dropdown populates based on the Credential you selected

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Enter Gmail search refine filters, like from:, to trigger the node on the filtered conditions only. Refer to Refine searches in Gmail for more information

parameters.name: Read Status
parameters.description: Choose whether to receive Unread and read emails, Unread emails only (default), or Read emails only

parameters.name: Sender
parameters.description: Enter an email or a part of a sender name to trigger only on messages from that sender

events.name: Message Received
events.description: The node triggers for new messages at the selected Poll Time
